h1: The 4 Best Professional Leaf Blowers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Professional Leaf Blowers: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 4 best professional gas backpack leaf blowers from Echo and Husqvarna, compared on CFM, price bucket and best use.
summary: The Echo X Series backpack blower is our top professional pick at 1110 CFM. The Husqvarna 580BTS follows at 1000 CFM, the Husqvarna 150BT is the lighter-duty 765 CFM option, and the 360BT sits between them on price.
intro: Professional blowers get judged on airflow numbers, but crews care just as much about the harness they wear all day. A blower that moves a lot of air and hangs badly on your back loses its advantage by the second hour.

We ranked four gas backpack blowers from Echo and Husqvarna using the listed CFM, format and price bucket. We kept the list to brands that sell professional-class backpack units, so the cheaper consumer blowers are excluded.

products.name: Echo 220 MPH 1110 CFM 79.9 cc Gas 2-Stroke X Series Backpack Blower
products.verdict: The highest airflow in the group, at 1110 CFM.
products.description:
The Echo X Series is a gas 2-stroke backpack blower with a 79.9 cc engine, rated 1110 CFM and 220 MPH. It is the strongest unit in this ranking.

It beats the Husqvarna 580BTS on both listed airflow figures, though both sit in the $500+ bucket. The tradeoff is the cost of the top spec.

Best for daily crew use on large properties. The caveat is that it is a gas unit with the maintenance that implies.
products.skipIf: You only clear a small yard.

products.name: Husqvarna 580BTS Gas Backpack Leaf Blower
products.verdict: 1000 CFM from a well-known professional brand.
products.description:
The Husqvarna 580BTS is a gas backpack blower rated 1000 CFM, in the $500+ bucket.

It ranks second because 1000 CFM trails the Echo's 1110, but it is the clear step above the 150BT. The tradeoff is a small airflow gap at a similar price.

Best for professionals who prefer Husqvarna. The caveat is that the listing provides few other specs.
products.idealFor: Pros who prefer the Husqvarna line.

products.name: Husqvarna 150BT Gas Leaf Blower
products.verdict: A 765 CFM backpack unit for under $500.
products.description:
The Husqvarna 150BT is a gas backpack blower rated 765 CFM, in the $200-500 bucket.

Third place suits it, since 765 CFM is well below the 580BTS, yet the price is lower. The tradeoff is airflow for price.

Best for lighter professional work, like small landscaping jobs. The caveat is that it will not match the top two on large clean-ups.
products.idealFor: Small landscaping jobs on a tighter budget.

products.name: Husqvarna 360BT Gas Leaf Blower
products.verdict: A backpack Husqvarna with no airflow figure listed.
products.description:
The Husqvarna 360BT is a gas backpack blower in the $200-500 bucket.

Fourth place is where it lands: with no CFM given, there is nothing to set against the 150BT's 765 CFM. The tradeoff is a lack of documented airflow.

Best for buyers already set on this model. The caveat is that you must check the airflow on the manufacturer's page before buying.

whatMatters.detail: CFM measures how much air moves each minute and decides how quickly you clear a large area. Higher is better for big properties. Look for the number in the title or bullets.
MPH shows how fast the air leaves the nozzle and helps lift wet or stuck debris. The Echo lists 220 MPH. Check whether the listing gives both CFM and MPH.
A backpack unit puts the weight on your back and not your arms. That makes long shifts bearable. Look for backpack in the listing.
Gas 2-stroke engines give strong power but need fuel mixing and upkeep. Check the engine size in cc and the fuel type.
Professional units run from $200 to over $500. Higher tiers add airflow. Check the current price before buying.

faq.q: What makes a leaf blower professional?
faq.a: Here, it means gas backpack units from professional lines with high airflow. They are built for long shifts.

faq.q: What is the common buying mistake?
faq.a: Buying on CFM alone. Check the harness and engine upkeep too.

faq.q: Is the Echo worth it over the Husqvarna 580BTS?
faq.a: If you want the highest numbers, yes, at 1110 versus 1000 CFM. The 580BTS suits Husqvarna loyalists.
Gas 2-stroke engines like the Echo's typically need a fuel mix. Check the manual.

faq.q: Why does the 360BT lack airflow figures?
faq.a: The listing does not give them, so check the manufacturer page.
They can be, but we kept to gas backpack units here.

finalTake: The Echo X Series is the best professional leaf blower here for its 1110 CFM. The Husqvarna 580BTS is the strong alternative, and the 150BT is the lighter-duty value. Check the 360BT's airflow before buying.
